query_plan.query: What is the average gini coefficient for each continent?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by continent, return as soon as the list is complete.
steps.query: Return all continents with name and id.

dependencies.dependency: Names and id of all continents.

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate the list by country, then group by continent and calculate the average gini coefficient for each continent.
steps.query: Return all countries with gini coefficient and continent name and id.

extra.sql_query: SELECT continents.name, AVG(countries.gini_coefficient) AS gini FROM countries INNER JOIN continents ON continents.continent = countries.continent GROUP BY continents.name

s2.sql_query: SELECT countries.country, countries.continent, countries.gini_coefficient, countries.name FROM countries
